title: Senior Software Engineer, SRE and Production Engineering - DGX Cloud
description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloud builds and operates large-scale GPU infrastructure for AI workloads. We are looking for Software Engineers with SRE or Production Engineering experience who have worked hands-on with bare-metal NVIDIA systems. This team builds the software and operational tooling that moves GPU capacity from installed hardware to production service supporting an IaaS production environment of BMaaS, VMaaS.

What you’ll be doing

• Build automation for bare-metal provisioning, hardware validation, firmware and software upgrades, repair, and cluster lifecycle management.

• Develop tools that interact with BMC and Redfish interfaces to monitor hardware health, manage server state, and assist recovery workflows.

• Handle and advance NVIDIA NVL72 systems and BlueField-3 or later DPUs throughout cloud partner and on-premises environments.

• Diagnose failures across servers, DPUs, GPU systems, CPU systems, networking, Linux, and Kubernetes; turn recurring issues into automated detection and repair.

• Define validation and handoff criteria so new capacity enters production safely and consistently.

• Take part in on-call duties, incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up to implement permanent solutions.

• Work with hardware, networking, platform, data center operations, and partner teams to resolve issues across ownership boundaries.

What we need to see:

• 5+ years building software for or operating production infrastructure, including substantial hands-on bare-metal experience.

• Strong Go or Python skills, with a record of delivering production automation and services.

• Direct experience with BMC and Redfish in server provisioning, health inspection, power management, or fault diagnosis.

• Practical experience working directly with NVIDIA GPU hardware, such as NVL72 systems, and BlueField-3 or newer DPUs.

• Experience with Linux, firmware and driver management, network boot, and the server lifecycle from initial provisioning through repair.

• Experience managing production reliability through on-call duties, incident response, observability, and durable solutions.

• Ability to debug failures across hardware, host operating systems, networking, and distributed services.

• Clear communication and demonstrated ownership of problems that span multiple teams.

• BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a practical setting.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Experience operating BlueField DPUs in DPU mode, including host-to-DPU connectivity and lifecycle debugging, with DPU or equivalent experience considered.

• Background with NVLink, InfiniBand, Spectrum-X, or GPU cluster performance validation.

• Experience building safe, repeatable workflows for rack-scale bringup, firmware upgrades, hardware replacement, and customer handoff.

• Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, Argo CD, SLOs, and fleet-wide automation.

At NVIDIA , you’ll help make next-generation AI infrastructure production-ready at scale!
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst - Mannheim
description:
Du fühlst dich im Vertrieb zu Hause und möchtest ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufbauen und verantworten? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Docker AI Substrate (Seattle or Palo Alto)
locationText: Palo Alto, CA or Seattle, WA
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As agents take on bigger jobs, the infrastructure around them matters more. Docker's answer is to give every agent a strong boundary, make its environment and authority reproducible, and let the work run where it makes sense, from a developer's laptop to the cloud. The Docker AI Substrate team brings that foundation to the enterprise: the largest companies in the world, running agents at scale, with the security, reliability, and control they expect from any critical system. We are a small, senior team at the start of that work. As a Staff Software Engineer here, you will shape the architecture, build the core systems, and run what you build.

Locations: Seattle, WA or Palo Alto, CA.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and build the systems that deploy, release, and operate Docker's agentic platform for enterprise customers, in Go and on Kubernetes.

- Make the platform run consistently across cloud providers and environments, with the security, identity, and network boundaries enterprises require.

- Own the release and supply chain path so every deployment is reproducible, verifiable, and trusted.

- Run what you build: production ownership, on-call, SLOs, incident response, and the operational tooling that keeps it boring.

- Set technical direction with the team's architect and engineering leadership, and work with partner teams across runtime, developer experience, identity, and observability.

- Raise the bar through design review, testing discipline, and mentorship as the team grows.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

- You have built and operated a cloud control and management plane. Software that provisions, upgrades, and watches infrastructure for many tenants or environments, in production, with a pager. Experience at a cloud provider, a managed-service vendor, or a platform team that stamps out environments.

- Kubernetes beyond deployment. You have written controllers or operators, understand reconciliation and CRDs, and know why declarative beats imperative at fleet scale.

- Deep in at least one major cloud. Hands-on with compute, networking, identity, and managed services, and able to pick up a second cloud fast.

- Production ownership. On-call, incident response, SLOs, post-mortems. You run what you build.

- Distributed systems design. Fault tolerance, consistency, observability, idempotent reconciliation.

- Go. Professional proficiency. Docker's backend and all of this team's code is Go.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering in infrastructure, platform, or cloud services, with the judgment to set direction for others.

STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Kubernetes resource orchestration and cloud controllers, such as KRO.

- Release engineering and software supply chain: OCI registries, digests, license compliance.

- Private connectivity between cloud accounts: PrivateLink, VPC peering, service endpoints, egress policy.

- OpenTelemetry pipelines with multiple destinations.

- Building managed services.

- Firecracker, microVMs, or other isolated execution environments for untrusted code.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis base

title: Senior Medical Science Liaison (Neurology); West Region
description:
About Us

We are developing potentially best-in-class therapies for patients living with severe autoimmune diseases. Our lead antibody, claseprubart (DNTH103), is purposefully engineered with extended half-life, improved potency, and high selectivity for only the active C1s complement protein that drives disease pathology - enabling less frequent and more convenient self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our second clinical candidate, DNTH212 is a first and potentially best in class, bifunctional inhibitor that targets clinically validated and complementary disease modifying mechanisms, Type 1 IFN suppression and B cell modulation - enabling potential for improved clinical outcomes and patient friendly convenient, self-administered subcutaneous injections. Our newest candidate, DNTH312, is an internally developed, investigational, first-in-class, next-generation bifunctional fusion protein combining claseprubart and TACI to target potent inhibition of aC1s and BAFF/APRIL. DNTH312 aims to be Phase 1 ready by year end 2027. To learn more, please visit www.dianthustx.com  and follow us on LinkedIn .

Dianthus Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to support the advancement of our neuromuscular disease portfolio, including myasthenia gravis (MG), chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP), and multifocal motor neuropathy (MMN). The biggest challenge for advertisers in physical retail is the lack of measurable proof of effectiveness. Brands invest millions in advertising at the point of sale, but they cannot demonstrate whether those investments actually generated purchases.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) solves this problem. We market and operate digital advertising screens across several thousand grocery, drugstore and convenience store locations, connecting them with digital coupons and retargeting campaigns on connected TV (CTV) and other offsite channels.

Brands don’t book isolated advertising formats; instead, they book 360-degree campaigns that start at home and continue all the way through to an in-store purchase. This enables closed-loop measurement based on actual point-of-sale transaction data.

A critical focus of this role will be building products that scale globally, with a specific emphasis on spearheading our rollout and expansion into the US market. Your goal is to turn complex location and behavioral data into intelligent, monetizable media channels that drive measurable results.

title: Psicólogos
description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos el proveedor líder en beneficios de salud mental para colaboradores, brindando servicio a más de 17 millones de personas en todo el mundo y cubriendo 585, 000 vidas en Latinoamérica. Lyra Health está transformando el acceso a una atención de salud mental que cambia vidas.

Lyra es una empresa reconocida a nivel internacional que brinda Programas de Apoyo al Empleado (PAE) a organizaciones en distintos países. Nuestro objetivo es promover el bienestar emocional de los colaboradores y sus familias a través de servicios. 

Nuestra Cultura y Valores

En Lyra transformamos el acceso a atención de salud mental que cambia vidas… comprometidos en el día a día con nuestros valores globales; Poner al cliente primero, Seguir la evidencia científica, Ser transparente, Escuchar con atención, Mirar hacia adentro, Enfrentar los retos y Cuidar de ti mismo.

¿En qué consiste? 

Buscamos psicólogos que deseen integrarse a nuestra red profesional para brindar atención presencial bajo un modelo de intervención breve. 
Los colaboradores de empresas afiliadas, así como sus familiares directos, acceden a nuestro Call Center en México (operado por psicólogos). Tras una evaluación inicial, los casos pueden ser referidos a sesiones presenciales.
El número de sesiones por caso varía, dependiendo del contrato establecido por la empresa. 

Principales características del programa:

* Servicio totalmente confidencial 
* No se requiere exclusividad de horario
* No se garantiza número fijo de clientes 
* Pago por transferencia electrónica bancaria al cierre del caso

Extendemos de manera gratuita para nuestros afiliados y sus familiares directos los servicios telefónicos que suministran: 

* Orientación Legal
* Orientación Alimentaria
* Orientación Financiera
* Asesoría emocional
* Información del día a día
 
Nuestro compromiso

Buscamos construir una red profesional sólida, colaborativa y de beneficio mutuo. No sólo solicitamos tu participación eventual en nuestros servicios, también queremos ser un respaldo para ti. 
Si deseas formar parte de una red internacional comprometida con el bienestar emocional, te identificas con este perfil y quieres impactar en la vida de las personas, postúlate y te contactaremos tan pronto como sea posible.

title: Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect
description:
About POMS
POMS develops Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software solutions for the life sciences industry. POMS is investing heavily in automated quality engineering, modern software delivery practices, and AI-assisted testing to further product quality and accelerate delivery.

Position Summary
POMS is seeking a hands-on Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect to lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to automation-driven quality engineering. This is a hands-on role: the successful candidate will personally help enhance the automation foundation (Playwright framework, standards, and CI/CD integration) and lead a global QA team to deliver automation at scale, using data to measure outcomes and prioritize investments.

Key Responsibilities

Automation Strategy and Architecture

• Own POMS' test automation strategy and roadmap, serving as technical lead for the Playwright framework, automation standards, coding guidelines, and review practices.

• Design and build scalable Playwright suites in TypeScript, making effective use of fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces, and reporting.

• Organize workflow-based testing suites with clear smoke, core regression, and release regression layers across functional, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

• Assess the existing manual test inventory and prioritize which tests should be automated, redesigned, consolidated, kept manual, or retired

• Partner with Development and DevOps to enhance our automated regression pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), with sound environment, test-data, and parallel-execution strategies across TFVC and Git repositories.

• Apply AI-assisted tools to test generation, maintenance, coverage analysis, and defect identification, and evaluate emerging testing tools and practices.

Team Leadership

• Build, mentor, and develop a small, high-performing QA team, with particular responsibility for building automation capability

• Put in place the standards, coaching, delegation, and ownership models that allow the team to scale automation without relying on the lead to author most tests.

• Set goals, performance expectations, and career development plans, and support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning.

• Foster quality ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Quality and Release Management

• Champion shift-left and risk-based testing, and participate in requirements, design, and architecture reviews to identify risks early.

• Define data-driven release readiness criteria and quality gates, and own QA for all software releases.

• Build operational and executive dashboards and KPIs covering automation coverage, defect escape rates, release readiness, and team performance, and use them to prioritize investments.

• Lead root cause analysis of escaped defects and implement preventive improvements.

• Support validation and compliance activities within a regulated software environment.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of software quality assurance and testing experience

• Expert-level experience building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable tools, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills.

Visual Design Leadership (Defining Responsibility)

• Ensure scoring loops, streak mechanics, and progression tier displays feel motivating and identity-consistent - not a generic gamification model
Motion Design & Interaction (Critical)

• Design and spec all animated moments, including the readiness score arc animation, the pre-launch cinematic welcome experience, identity ambient recolor, mission/achievement completion states, AI coaching insight reveals, and score/pillar change reveals

• Define motion standards for the full product: screen transitions, micro-interactions, press states, loading states, skeleton screens, empty states, and error states

• Produce implementation-ready motion specs for multiple devices: Bodymovin/Lottie files, timing curves, duration values, and engineering handoff notes

UX/UI Design Across the Full Screen Inventory

• Design action-oriented experiences that tell the user what to do next; every screen should have a clear direction rather than a passive display of data

• Translate complex biomarker, wearable, and AI-generated data into interfaces that are immediately readable and emotionally resonant - not dense, clinical, or overwhelming

• Design the dashboard priority engine as the product's daily engagement surface - one that feels like a coach, not a notification list

• Design an AI coaching modal as a distinct experience layer, and maintain high-fidelity designs across iOS, Android, and Web s

description:
岗位描述

7、探索 AI/LLM 技术在交易风控场景的落地应用，如异常订单行为智能检测、策略规则自动推荐、风险事件归因分析

任职要求

1、全日制本科及以上学历，计算机科学、统计学、数学、金融工程或相关专业；3 年以上风控模型/策略开发经验，有交易所或券商交易风控背景者优先
2、熟练掌握至少一种编程语言Python、Java、Go，具备扎实的数据处理与建模能力，能独立完成从数据清洗、特征工程到模型上线的全流程工作
3、熟悉主流机器学习模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、逻辑回归、时序异常检测等）及其在高频交易数据场景下的工程化落地
4、熟悉图数据库（Neo4j、NebulaGraph 等）及社区发现算法（Louvain、LPA 等），有关联账户识别或团伙挖掘实战经验
5、熟悉实时流处理技术（Flink、Kafka 等），具备生产级别的毫秒级风控策略落地能力，覆盖从数据预处理、特征工程、模型训练到策略应用的全流程，能够保障在极端行情或高频交易场景下实现实时风险阻断

加分项

1、熟悉TradFi 品种金融规则：熟悉股票、ETF、外汇市场的交易规则，能有效将传统合规风控模型迁移至 TradFi 风控场景。
2、AI/LLM 应用经验：有将 LLM 实际用于风控场景的真实案例（用户异常行为识别、策略自动生成、风险报告自动化）。

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This position sits in our  Marketing & Technology service based in London. We combine data, technology, creative content, and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like ad campaigns, augmented reality, and chatbots. Our clients include JustEat Takeaway, The Macallan, easyJet, TikTok, and eBay.

THE ROLE

DEPT's influencer practice runs creator programmes for brands across EMEA. We want creators in the plan from the first brief: shaping the brand's idea, feeding paid media and search, and reaching people in the communities where they already trust the voices they follow. We're hiring a senior strategist to lead that thinking on our client work.

You'll decide where creators earn their place in a client's plan, before production or media budget is committed, and run that strategy from brief to plan on your own. You'll work with clients and colleagues across the three regions, much of it by video, alongside our media, search, social and creative teams and a growth team that leads on new business. You'll be based in our Budapest office, where we're growing the influencer team.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead influencer strategy on priority client accounts across EMEA, from interrogating the brief to the plan our delivery teams work from.

• Bring creators in early, while the brand's idea can still change, so they test and shape it before it goes into production.

• Plan creator work with our Paid Social, Social, SEO and GEO, and Creative teams, so it's part of the integrated plan from day one.

• Clients and delivery teams can act on your strategies without rework.

• The accounts you lead grow, through new scopes and repeat work.

• Pitches you support show a clear influencer idea that clients respond to.

• Strategy work across the hubs gets sharper, and the strategists you coach take on more on their own.

• You can show an influencer strategy that won a pitch, grew an account or developed the business, and explain the thinking behind it.

• You know how creator content works with paid media, search and commerce, and you've planned for all three.

• You present clearly to senior clients in professional-level English. German or Dutch is a plus.

• You interrogate briefs deeply before you answer them.

• You work well with teams and brands across cultures.

• You are excellent at managing your own time and happy to dive into research, analysis, and synthesis without supervision.

• You're curious about how AI search and private channels are changing where people find and trust brands, and what that means for creators.

• An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies

• Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.

• 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).

ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Design the fabrics the frontier trains on. Lossless, non-blocking backend networks for clusters of 100k+ accelerators, re-derived for every new generation of silicon, often before the chip is public.

- Multiple fabrics, one system. Frontend, backend, backbone, management, enterprise, and BMS, designed as a single coherent architecture.

- Generate the design, don't draw it. Topologies, addressing, BGP/ASN schemas, and golden configs produced from a source-of-truth model, a full site network design in days instead of quarters, correct by construction.

title: Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.
